name: war_orc
brief: Orc warrior in heavy war armor. Sepia metal. Green skin, red eyes, open helmet, tusks. Red banner with violet mark on back tied to torso.

plan.overall_look: Side-view orc warlord: green skin, red eyes, open-face war helm, tusks. Heavy sepia-metal plate on torso, shoulders, arms, thighs, greaves and boots. Red war banner with violet clan mark rises from the back, strapped to the torso plate.

upper_arm_far.visual_notes: Far pauldron and upper-arm plate in sepia metal.

lower_arm_far.visual_notes: Far metallic bracer and gauntlet covering forearm and hand.

upper_leg_far.visual_notes: Far thigh cuisse in sepia metal.

lower_leg_far.visual_notes: Far greave and armored boot in sepia metal.

torso.visual_notes: Sepia metal breastplate and backplate; belt. Red banner pole and cloth on the back with violet geometric clan symbol; straps tie banner to torso.

head.visual_notes: Green orc head skin; red eyes covering base eyes; open-face war helmet rim in sepia metal (does not cover face); visible tusks in light beige/sepia.

lower_arm_near.visual_notes: Near metallic bracer and gauntlet covering forearm and hand.

upper_leg_near.visual_notes: Near thigh cuisse in sepia metal.

lower_leg_near.visual_notes: Near greave and armored boot in sepia metal.

user_facing_summary:
Outfit plan for `war_orc`
Brief: Orc warrior in heavy war armor. Sepia metal. Green skin, red eyes, open helmet, tusks. Red banner with violet mark on back tied to torso.

Overall look:
Side-view orc warlord: green skin, red eyes, open-face war helm, tusks. Heavy sepia-metal plate on torso, shoulders, arms, thighs, greaves and boots. Red war banner with violet clan mark rises from the back, strapped to the torso plate.

Design layers (same 10 names as base/layers/):
  - upper_arm_far: paint on [upper_arm_far] (pose parent=upper_arm_far) — Far pauldron and upper-arm plate in sepia metal.
  - lower_arm_far: paint on [lower_arm_far, hand_far] (pose parent=lower_arm_far) — Far metallic bracer and gauntlet covering forearm and hand.
  - upper_leg_far: paint on [upper_leg_far] (pose parent=upper_leg_far) — Far thigh cuisse in sepia metal.
  - lower_leg_far: paint on [lower_leg_far, foot_far] (pose parent=lower_leg_far) — Far greave and armored boot in sepia metal.
  - torso: paint on [torso] (pose parent=torso) — Sepia metal breastplate and backplate; belt. Red banner pole and cloth on the back with violet geometric clan symbol; straps tie banner to torso.
  - head: paint on [head] (pose parent=head) — Green orc head skin; red eyes covering base eyes; open-face war helmet rim in sepia metal (does not cover face); visible tusks in light beige/sepia.
  - upper_arm_near: paint on [upper_arm_near] (pose parent=upper_arm_near) — Near pauldron and upper-arm plate in sepia metal.
  - lower_arm_near: paint on [lower_arm_near, hand_near] (pose parent=lower_arm_near) — Near metallic bracer and gauntlet covering forearm and hand.
  - upper_leg_near: paint on [upper_leg_near] (pose parent=upper_leg_near) — Near thigh cuisse in sepia metal.
  - lower_leg_near: paint on [lower_leg_near, foot_near] (pose parent=lower_leg_near) — Near greave and armored boot in sepia metal.

Painting rule: for each active export layer, prepare_outfit_slot_reference then paint ONLY via MCP tools onto design/layers/<layer>.png (fill_parts_on_slot for that layer's body_parts silhouette; fill_rect / draw_line / paint_pixels for details). FORBIDDEN: Shell/PIL scripts or external image generators. Each design file rigid-rotates 1:1 with its body part (no multi-parent split). Clothing MAY overhang the body silhouette — body underlay is alignment reference, not a clip mask; keep proportions sensible. If this matches, say OK and paint layers; otherwise revise the plan.
